title: Active Prompting Explained: Boost AI Reasoning with Less Human Effort
firstLines: How can large language models become better at reasoning without requiring massive amounts of human-labeled data? In this video, we explore Active Prompting, an advanced prompting technique that improves AI performance by focusing human effort only where it's needed most.

Instead of manually annotating entire datasets, Active Prompting identifies questions where the model is uncertain, inconsistent, or likely to make mistakes. Human experts then provide high-quality reasoning examples for these challenging cases, helping the model learn more effectively while dramatically reducing labeling costs.
